name: Craft CMS
support: Pixel & Tonic; commercial licensing with a free Solo edition; community and professional support.
technology: PHP and Yii 2 on the server; MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL database; Twig templates; HTML, CSS and JavaScript in the browser; GraphQL API.
capabilities: Flexible custom content fields and structures
limitations: Custom site builds generally need PHP/Twig development
Needs maintained server, database and security updates

name: Statamic
support: Independent commercial/open-core CMS built on Laravel; free options and paid professional licenses/support.
technology: PHP and Laravel server; flat-file Markdown/YAML content by default (database storage optional); Antlers or Blade templates; HTML/CSS/JavaScript in browser.
capabilities: Custom content fields, assets and forms
limitations: Some uses require a paid license
Large or complex content workflows may benefit from database configuration

name: ProcessWire
support: Free open-source CMS and framework; community forum and optional commercial modules/support.
technology: PHP server; MySQL or MariaDB database; PHP template files; HTML/CSS/JavaScript browser frontend.
capabilities: Highly customizable fields, page structure and templates
Powerful content querying through PHP API
limitations: Developer-focused, with fewer turnkey themes than some competitors
PHP development needed for many custom designs

name: Grav CMS
support: Free, open-source project maintained by the Grav team/Trilby Media, with community and optional paid services.
technology: PHP with Symfony components and Twig templates; Markdown/YAML flat files instead of a database; JavaScript-enabled browser admin and frontend.
capabilities: REST API and administrative interface in Grav 2
limitations: Complex relationships and high-volume content may be less convenient in flat files
Hosting still needs PHP and regular updates
Some administration functions require added plugins or setup

name: Concrete CMS
support: Free open-source CMS maintained by Concrete CMS/PortlandLabs; hosted plans and professional support offered.
technology: PHP server, MySQL or MariaDB database; PHP-based content blocks/themes; HTML/CSS/JavaScript in browser.
capabilities: Edit content directly on the page
limitations: Requires PHP/database hosting and maintenance when self-hosted
Hosted plans may limit access to code and extensions
